## 1. 实验设计与数据说明

### 1.1 8个实验条件

| 设计 | groupID | P (练习试次) | T (呈现时间ms) | W (反应窗口ms) | 特点 |
|------|---------|--------------|----------------|----------------|------|
| D1   | 1       | 0            | 30             | 300            | 极端低资源 |
| D2   | 2       | 0            | 30             | 600            | 低资源 |
| D3a  | 3       | 120          | 30             | 600            | P效应(低T) |
| D4a  | 4       | 120          | 80             | 600            | T效应 |
| D5   | 5       | 8            | 100            | 1100           | 中等资源 |
| D6   | 6       | 120          | 500            | 1500           | 高资源/饱和 |
| D3b  | 8       | 120          | 30             | 800            | P效应(高W) |
| D4b  | 9       | 120          | 80             | 800            | T效应(高W) |

## 2. 加载实证数据

```{r design-mapping}
# ==============================================================================
# 实验设计映射表
# 定义groupID与实验条件(P, T, W)的对应关系
# ==============================================================================

design_map <- tribble(
  ~groupID, ~design_name, ~P, ~T, ~W,
  1, "D1", 0, 30, 300,
  2, "D2", 0, 30, 600,
  3, "D3a", 120, 30, 600,
  4, "D4a", 120, 80, 600,
  5, "D5", 8, 100, 1100,
  6, "D6", 120, 500, 1500,
  8, "D3b", 120, 30, 800,
  9, "D4b", 120, 80, 800
)

# 用于显示的顺序
design_order <- c("D1", "D2", "D3a", "D4a", "D5", "D6", "D3b", "D4b")

cat("实验设计映射表：\n")
print(design_map)
```

### 2.2 从CSV文件加载实证数据

```{r load-empirical-data}
# ==============================================================================
# 从原始CSV文件加载实证数据
# 数据路径：3_Study3_Empirical/data/raw/emp_data/
# ==============================================================================

# 数据目录路径
data_dir <- "3_Study3_Empirical/data/raw/emp_data"

# 获取所有CSV文件
csv_files <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# 过滤掉NoMask_data目录和其他非数据文件
csv_files <- csv_files[!grepl("NoMask|sim_data|\\.DS_Store", csv_files)]

cat("找到", length(csv_files), "个数据文件\n")

# 读取并合并所有数据
all_data <- data.frame()
for (f in csv_files) {
  tryCatch({
    d <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  })
}

cat("成功加载", nrow(all_data), "行数据\n")
cat("数据列名：", names(all_data), "\n")
```

### 2.3 计算实证数据统计量

```{r compute-empirical-stats}
# ==============================================================================
# 计算实证数据的统计量
# 包括：
#   - mean_RT_self: self条件的平均反应时间
#   - mean_RT_stranger: stranger条件的平均反应时间
#   - mean_ACC_self: self条件的准确率
#   - mean_ACC_stranger: stranger条件的准确率
#   - d_RT: Cohen's d (RT: stranger - self) / SD_pooled
#   - d_ACC: Cohen's d (ACC: self - stranger) / SD_pooled
# ==============================================================================

# 数据预处理：移除缺失值和无效试次
clean_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(RT),           # 移除RT缺失
    !is.na(Correct),      # 移除Correct缺失
    RT > 0,               # 移除异常RT
    Label %in% c("self", "stranger")  # 只保留self/stranger
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    RT_ms = RT * 1000  # 转换为毫秒
  )

cat("清理后数据：", nrow(clean_data), "行\n")

# 按groupID和Label计算各条件的统计量
emp_stats <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(groupID, Label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trials = n(),
    mean_RT = mean(RT_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_RT = sd(RT_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ACC = mean(Correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ACC = sd(Correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 转换为宽格式：self和stranger分开
emp_self <- emp_stats %>%
  filter(Label == "self") %>%
  rename(
    n_self = n_trials,
    mean_RT_self = mean_RT,
    sd_RT_self = sd_RT,
    mean_ACC_self = mean_ACC,
    sd_ACC_self = sd_ACC
  ) %>%
  select(-Label)

emp_stranger <- emp_stats %>%
  filter(Label == "stranger") %>%
  rename(
    n_stranger = n_trials,
    mean_RT_stranger = mean_RT,
    sd_RT_stranger = sd_RT,
    mean_ACC_stranger = mean_ACC,
    sd_ACC_stranger = sd_ACC
  ) %>%
  select(-Label)

# 合并self和stranger数据
emp_merged <- emp_self %>%
  inner_join(emp_stranger, by = "groupID") %>%
  inner_join(design_map, by = "groupID") %>%
  mutate(
    # Cohen's d for RT: (RT_stranger - RT_self) / SD_pooled
    # 正值表示self比stranger更快
    d_RT = (mean_RT_stranger - mean_RT_self) / 
            sqrt(((n_self - 1) * sd_RT_self^2 + (n_stranger - 1) * sd_RT_stranger^2) / 
                 (n_self + n_stranger - 2)),
    
    # Cohen's d for ACC: (ACC_self - ACC_stranger) / SD_pooled
    # 正值表示self比stranger更准确
    d_ACC = (mean_ACC_self - mean_ACC_stranger) /
             sqrt(((n_self - 1) * sd_ACC_self^2 + (n_stranger - 1) * sd_ACC_stranger^2) /
                  (n_self + n_stranger - 2))
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(design_name, design_order))

cat("\n实证数据统计结果：\n")
print(emp_merged[, c("design_name", "groupID", "P", "T", "W", 
                      "mean_RT_self", "mean_RT_stranger", "d_RT",
                      "mean_ACC_self", "mean_ACC_stranger", "d_ACC")])
```

### 2.4 保存实证数据为CSV（供后续使用）

```{r save-empirical-csv}
# ==============================================================================
# 将计算好的实证数据保存为CSV文件
# 便于后续直接加载而不需要重新处理原始数据
# ==============================================================================

# 准备输出数据
emp_output <- emp_merged %>%
  select(
    design_name, groupID, P, T, W,
    n_self, n_stranger,
    mean_RT_self, sd_RT_self, mean_RT_stranger, sd_RT_stranger,
    mean_ACC_self, sd_ACC_self, mean_ACC_stranger, sd_ACC_stranger,
    d_RT, d_ACC
  ) %>%

    emp_sd_RT_self = sd_RT_self,
    emp_mean_RT_stranger = mean_RT_stranger,
    emp_sd_RT_stranger = sd_RT_stranger,
    emp_mean_ACC_self = mean_ACC_self,
    emp_sd_ACC_self = sd_ACC_self,
    emp_mean_ACC_stranger = mean_ACC_stranger,
    emp_sd_ACC_stranger = sd_ACC_stranger,
    emp_d_RT = d_RT,
    emp_d_ACC = d_ACC
  )

# 保存
write.csv(emp_output, "empirical_data_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("实证数据已保存到: empirical_data_summary.csv\n")
```

## 3. DDM模型定义

### 3.1 基础模型参数

```{r model-base-params}
# ==============================================================================
# DDM模型基础参数
# 这些参数在网格搜索中保持不变
# ==============================================================================

# 边界参数
BETA2 <- 0.0    # 当 M <= 600 时的边界调整系数

# 非决策时间（秒）- 心理编码和运动时间
T0 <- 0.2

# P学习效应的gamma参数
GAMMA <- 0.2

# Self/Stranger的alpha倍数（核心假设：self有更高的信息加工效率）
ALPHA1 <- 1.5   # self条件的alpha倍数
ALPHA2 <- 0.4   # stranger条件的alpha倍数

cat("基础参数：\n")
cat("  BETA2 =", BETA2, "\n")
cat("  T0 =", T0, "秒\n")
cat("  GAMMA =", GAMMA, "\n")
cat("  ALPHA1 (self) =", ALPHA1, "\n")
cat("  ALPHA2 (stranger) =", ALPHA2, "\n")
```

### 3.2 P学习效应函数

```{r v-p-func}
# ==============================================================================
# v_P_func: 练习试次P对漂移率的非线性影响
# 
# 使用sigmoid函数建模：
#   - P=0时，v_P接近0（无练习，漂移率低）
#   - P增加时，v_P先快速增加后趋于稳定

#   P: 练习试次数量
#   P1: sigmoid曲线的中点
#   k_min, k_max: 曲线斜率的范围
#   gamma: 曲线的曲率参数
#   P0: 曲线的位移参数
# ==============================================================================

v_P_func <- function(P, P1 = 4, k_min = 0.01, k_max = 0.15, 
                     gamma = 0.1, P0 = 32) {
  # 计算动态斜率k
  k <- k_min + (k_max - k_min) / (1 + exp(-gamma * (P - P0)))
  
  # 应用sigmoid变换
  1 / (1 + exp(-k * (P - P1)))
}
```

### 3.3 边界a计算函数

```{r a-func}
# ==============================================================================
# compute_a: 计算边界分离度（boundary separation）
# 
# 边界a代表"反应谨慎程度"：
#   - a越大，被试越谨慎，需要更多证据才做出反应
#   - a越小，被试反应越冲动
#
# M = T + W（总可用决策时间，毫秒）

#   M: 总可用时间 (T + W, 毫秒)
#   beta1: 边界调整系数（当M>600时应用）
# ==============================================================================

compute_a <- function(M, beta1 = 0.2) {
  # 计算基础边界（sigmoid函数）
  a_0 <- 1 / (1 + exp(-0.01 * (M - 600))) * 3
  
  # 根据M的大小调整边界
  if (M > 600) {
    # 反应窗口充足时，被试更谨慎，边界更高
    a_0 * (1 + beta1)
  } else {
    # 时间紧迫时，被试更冲动
    a_0 * (1 + BETA2)
  }
}
```

### 3.4 DDM模拟函数

```{r ddm-simulate}
# ==============================================================================
# 返回值：
#   list(rt = rts, resp = resps)
#     rt: 反应时间向量（毫秒）
#     resp: 反应向量 (1 = self, 2 = stranger)
# ==============================================================================

simulate_cond <- function(P, T, W, ck, v_max, beta1, t0 = T0, 
                         z_ratio = 0.5, noise_scale = 1.0,
                         alpha1 = ALPHA1, alpha2 = ALPHA2,
                         n_sub = 3, n_tri = 200) {
  
  # 总可用决策时间（毫秒）
  M <- T + W
  
  # 最大模拟时间（秒）
  # 包含非决策时间，并额外加1ms确保覆盖
  mt <- (W + T - t0) * 0.001 + 0.001
  mts <- as.integer(mt / 0.001)  # 模拟步数（每步1ms）
  
  # 计算边界a
  ab <- compute_a(M, beta1)
  
  # 存储反应时间和反应
  rts <- c()
  resps <- c()
  
  # 遍历每个模拟被试
  for (s in 1:n_sub) {
    # 被试间边界变异：每个被试的边界有轻微随机波动
    a <- max(rnorm(1, ab, 0.3), 0.01)
    
    # 遍历每个试次
    for (t in 1:n_tri) {
      # ========================================
      # 步骤1：计算漂移率 v
      # ========================================
      
      # T的效应：呈现时间对漂移率的影响
      # T越长，被试有更多时间加工信息，漂移率越高
      v_T <- 1 / (1 + exp(-0.01 * (T - 100)))
      
      # P的效应：练习试次对漂移率的影响
      v_P_val <- v_P_func(P, P1 = 4, k_min = 0.1, k_max = 0.05, 
                          gamma = GAMMA, P0 = 32)
      
      # 基线漂移率
      v_0 <- v_T * v_P_val * 3
      
      # 根据条件应用alpha倍数
      # 核心假设：self条件的信息加工效率更高
      if (ck == 1) {
        v <- v_0 * (1 + alpha1)  # self条件
      } else {
        v <- v_0 * (1 - alpha2)  # stranger条件
      }
      
      # 添加漂移率上限（防止D6等条件下的过高漂移率）
      v <- min(v, v_max)
      
      # 添加过程噪声（使模型具有随机性）
      v <- rnorm(1, v, noise_scale)
      
      # ========================================
      # 步骤2：设置起始点 z
      # ========================================
      # 起始点z代表决策开始时的先验偏向
      # z = z_ratio * a 意味着从边界的某个比例处开始
      
      z <- a * z_ratio
      x <- z  # 证据积累的当前位置
      
      # ========================================
      # 步骤3：证据积累过程
      # ========================================
      # 离散时间Wiener过程：
      #   x_{t+1} = x_t + v * dt + N(0, dt)
      # 其中dt = 0.001秒（1毫秒）
      
      time <- 0  # 积累时间（秒）
      resp <- 0  # 反应结果
      
      for (step in 1:mts) {
        # 证据积累：漂移 + 噪声
        x <- x + v * 0.001 + rnorm(1) * sqrt(0.001)
        time <- time + 0.001
        
        # 检查是否达到上边界（反应self）
        if (x >= a) {
          resp <- 1  # 反应"self"
          break
        }
        
        # 检查是否达到下边界（反应stranger）
        if (x <= 0) {
          resp <- 2  # 反应"stranger"
          break
        }
      }
      
      # ========================================
      # 步骤4：记录有效试次
      # ========================================
      # 只有在超时前完成决策的试次才有效
      if (time + t0 < mt) {
        # 加上非决策时间T0，转换为毫秒
        rts <- c(rts, (time + t0) * 1000)
        resps <- c(resps, resp)
      }
    }
  }
  
  list(rt = rts, resp = resps)
}
```

### 3.5 效应量计算函数

```{r effect-size-funcs}
# ==============================================================================
# cd_rt: 计算Cohen's d (反应时间)
#
# 公式：d = (M2 - M1) / SD_pooled
#   对于RT: d_RT = (RT_stranger - RT_self) / SD_pooled
#   正值表示self比stranger更快
#
# 参数：
#   a: self条件的RT向量
#   b: stranger条件的RT向量
# ==============================================================================

cd_rt <- function(a, b) {
  n1 <- length(a)
  n2 <- length(b)
  
  # 检查样本量
  if (n1 < 2 || n2 < 2) return(NA)
  
  # 计算标准差
  sd1 <- sd(a)
  sd2 <- sd(b)
  
  # 防止除零
  if (sd1 == 0 && sd2 == 0) return(0)
  
  # 计算pooled SD
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * sd1^2 + (n2 - 1) * sd2^2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
  
  # 计算Cohen's d
  (mean(b) - mean(a)) / pooled_sd
}

# ==============================================================================
# cd_acc: 计算Cohen's d (准确率)
#
# 公式：d = (M1 - M2) / SD_pooled
#   对于ACC: d_ACC = (ACC_self - ACC_stranger) / SD_pooled
#   正值表示self比stranger更准确
#
# 参数：
#   a: self条件的ACC向量 (0或1)
#   b: stranger条件的ACC向量 (0或1)
# ==============================================================================

cd_acc <- function(a, b) {
  n1 <- length(a)
  n2 <- length(b)
  
  if (n1 < 2 || n2 < 2) return(NA)
  
  sd1 <- sd(a)
  sd2 <- sd(b)
  
  if (sd1 == 0 && sd2 == 0) {
    # 如果两者SD都是0，检查均值差异
    return(ifelse(mean(a) != mean(b), sign(mean(a) - mean(b)) * Inf, 0))
  }
  
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * sd1^2 + (n2 - 1) * sd2^2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
  
  (mean(a) - mean(b)) / pooled_sd
}
```

## 4. 网格搜索优化

### 4.1 定义搜索参数空间

```{r grid-params}
# ==============================================================================
# 参数网格定义
# 在以下参数空间内进行系统搜索：
#   - v_max: 漂移率上限 (2.0 - 5.0)
#   - noise_scale: 过程噪声 (0.5 - 3.0)
#   - BETA1: 边界调整系数 (0.1 - 0.5)
#   - z_ratio: 起始点比例 (0.3 - 0.7)
# 这些参数范围基于Tran 2021文献中的参考值
# ==============================================================================

# 参数网格
v_max_grid <- seq(2.0, 5.0, by = 0.5)      # 漂移率上限
noise_grid <- seq(0.5, 3.0, by = 0.5)     # 噪声标准差
beta1_grid <- seq(0.1, 0.5, by = 0.1)     # 边界调整系数
z_ratio_grid <- seq(0.3, 0.7, by = 0.1)   # 起始点比例

# 计算总组合数
total_combos <- length(v_max_grid) * length(noise_grid) * 
                length(beta1_grid) * length(z_ratio_grid)

cat("参数网格：\n")
cat("  v_max:", v_max_grid, "\n")
cat("  noise_scale:", noise_grid, "\n")
cat("  BETA1:", beta1_grid, "\n")
cat("  z_ratio:", z_ratio_grid, "\n")
cat("\n总组合数:", total_combos, "\n")
```

### 4.2 运行网格搜索

```{r run-grid-search, eval=FALSE}
# 注意：这个代码块可能需要较长时间运行
# 如果需要快速测试，可以减少参数网格大小
# ==============================================================================

cat("开始网格搜索...\n")
cat("预计总组合数:", total_combos, "\n")

# 存储结果
results <- data.frame()
combo_id <- 0

# 进度报告
start_time <- Sys.time()

# 遍历所有参数组合
for (v_max in v_max_grid) {
  for (noise_scale in noise_grid) {
    for (beta1 in beta1_grid) {
      for (z_ratio in z_ratio_grid) {
        combo_id <- combo_id + 1
        
        # 存储每个条件的误差
        errors <- c()
        
        # 对每个实验条件进行模拟
        for (i in 1:nrow(emp_output)) {
          r <- emp_output[i, ]
          
          # 模拟self条件
          set.seed(42)
          ss <- simulate_cond(
            P = r$P, T = r$T, W = r$W, ck = 1,
            v_max = v_max, beta1 = beta1, z_ratio = z_ratio,
            noise_scale = noise_scale, n_tri = 200
          )
          
          # 模拟stranger条件
          set.seed(42)
          sst <- simulate_cond(
            P = r$P, T = r$T, W = r$W, ck = 0,
            v_max = v_max, beta1 = beta1, z_ratio = z_ratio,
            noise_scale = noise_scale, n_tri = 200
          )
          
          # 计算模拟的效应量
          sim_d_rt <- cd_rt(ss$rt, sst$rt)
          sim_d_acc <- cd_acc(as.numeric(ss$resp == 1), 
                              as.numeric(sst$resp == 1))
          
          # 计算模拟的均值
          sim_mean_rt_self <- mean(ss$rt)
          sim_mean_rt_stranger <- mean(sst$rt)
          sim_mean_acc_self <- mean(ss$resp == 1)
          sim_mean_acc_stranger <- mean(sst$resp == 1)
          
          # 计算误差
          err_d_rt <- abs(sim_d_rt - r$emp_d_RT)
          err_d_acc <- abs(sim_d_acc - r$emp_d_ACC)
          err_mean_rt <- (abs(sim_mean_rt_self - r$emp_mean_RT_self) + 
                         abs(sim_mean_rt_stranger - r$emp_mean_RT_stranger)) / 2
          err_mean_acc <- (abs(sim_mean_acc_self - r$emp_mean_ACC_self) + 
                          abs(sim_mean_acc_stranger - r$emp_mean_ACC_stranger)) / 2
          
          errors <- c(errors, list(
            design = r$design_name,
            err_d_rt = err_d_rt,
            err_d_acc = err_d_acc,
            err_mean_rt = err_mean_rt,
            err_mean_acc = err_mean_acc
          ))
        }
        
        # 计算综合MAE
        mae_d_rt <- mean(sapply(errors, function(x) x$err_d_rt))
        mae_d_acc <- mean(sapply(errors, function(x) x$err_d_acc))
        mae_mean_rt <- mean(sapply(errors, function(x) x$err_mean_rt))
        mae_mean_acc <- mean(sapply(errors, function(x) x$err_mean_acc))
        
        # 综合MAE（可调整权重）
        # 这里给d_RT更高权重，因为它是最主要的优化目标
        mae_combined <- 0.4 * mae_d_rt + 0.3 * mae_d_acc + 
                        0.15 * mae_mean_rt + 0.15 * mae_mean_acc
        
        # 记录结果
        results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
          combo_id = combo_id,
          v_max = v_max,
          noise_scale = noise_scale,
          beta1 = beta1,
          z_ratio = z_ratio,
          mae_d_rt = mae_d_rt,
          mae_d_acc = mae_d_acc,
          mae_mean_rt = mae_mean_rt,
          mae_mean_acc = mae_mean_acc,
          mae_combined = mae_combined,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ))
        
        # 进度报告
        if (combo_id %% 50 == 0) {
          cat(sprintf("已完成 %d/%d 组合 (%.1f%%)\n", 
                     combo_id, total_combos, 
                     100 * combo_id / total_combos))
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# 运行时间
end_time <- Sys.time()
cat(sprintf("\n网格搜索完成！\n"))
cat(sprintf("总耗时: %.1f 秒\n", 
            difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs")))

# 按综合MAE排序
results <- results %>% arrange(mae_combined)

cat("\n=== TOP 10 结果 (按综合MAE排序) ===\n")
print(head(results, 10))
```

## 7. 最优参数分析

### 7.1 最优参数组合

```{r best-params}
# ==============================================================================
# 提取最优参数组合
# ==============================================================================

# 如果results存在，找出最优参数
if (exists("results") && nrow(results) > 0) {
  best <- results[1, ]
  
  cat("=== 最优参数组合 ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("v_max = %.1f\n", best$v_max))
  cat(sprintf("noise_scale = %.1f\n", best$noise_scale))
  cat(sprintf("BETA1 = %.1f\n", best$beta1))
  cat(sprintf("z_ratio = %.2f\n", best$z_ratio))
  
  cat("\n=== 误差指标 ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("MAE (d_RT) = %.4f\n", best$mae_d_rt))
  cat(sprintf("MAE (d_ACC) = %.4f\n", best$mae_d_acc))
  cat(sprintf("MAE (mean RT) = %.2f ms\n", best$mae_mean_rt))
  cat(sprintf("MAE (mean ACC) = %.4f\n", best$mae_mean_acc))
  cat(sprintf("MAE (综合) = %.4f\n", best$mae_combined))
  
  # 保存最优参数
  best_params <- best[, c("v_max", "noise_scale", "beta1", "z_ratio")]
} else {
  # 使用默认参数
  best_params <- data.frame(
    v_max = 3.0,
    noise_scale = 2.0,
    beta1 = 0.3,
    z_ratio = 0.5
  )
  cat("使用默认参数继续\n")
}
```

### 7.2 最优参数下的详细对比

```{r detailed-comparison}
# ==============================================================================
# 使用最优参数运行完整模拟，并与实证数据进行详细对比
# ==============================================================================

# 提取参数
v_max_opt <- best_params$v_max
noise_opt <- best_params$noise_scale
beta1_opt <- best_params$beta1
z_ratio_opt <- best_params$z_ratio

# 存储对比结果
comparison <- data.frame()

cat("\n=== 各条件详细对比 ===\n\n")

for (i in 1:nrow(emp_output)) {
  r <- emp_output[i, ]
  
  # 模拟self条件（增加试次数以获得更稳定的结果）
  set.seed(42)
  ss <- simulate_cond(
    P = r$P, T = r$T, W = r$W, ck = 1,
    v_max = v_max_opt, beta1 = beta1_opt, z_ratio = z_ratio_opt,
    noise_scale = noise_opt, n_tri = 500
  )
  
  # 模拟stranger条件
  set.seed(42)
  sst <- simulate_cond(
    P = r$P, T = r$T, W = r$W, ck = 0,
    v_max = v_max_opt, beta1 = beta1_opt, z_ratio = z_ratio_opt,
    noise_scale = noise_opt, n_tri = 500
  )
  
  # 计算模拟统计量
  sim_d_rt <- cd_rt(ss$rt, sst$rt)
  sim_d_acc <- cd_acc(as.numeric(ss$resp == 1), 
                      as.numeric(sst$resp == 1))
  sim_mean_rt_self <- mean(ss$rt)
  sim_mean_rt_stranger <- mean(sst$rt)
  sim_mean_acc_self <- mean(ss$resp == 1)
  sim_mean_acc_stranger <- mean(sst$resp == 1)
  
  # 计算误差
  err_d_rt <- abs(sim_d_rt - r$emp_d_RT)
  err_d_acc <- abs(sim_d_acc - r$emp_d_ACC)
  
  # 存储结果
  comparison <- rbind(comparison, data.frame(
    design = r$design_name,
    # 实证数据
    emp_d_RT = r$emp_d_RT,
    emp_d_ACC = r$emp_d_ACC,
    emp_mean_RT_self = r$emp_mean_RT_self,
    emp_mean_RT_stranger = r$emp_mean_RT_stranger,
    emp_mean_ACC_self = r$emp_mean_ACC_self,
    emp_mean_ACC_stranger = r$emp_mean_ACC_stranger,
    # 模型预测
    sim_d_RT = sim_d_rt,
    sim_d_ACC = sim_d_acc,
    sim_mean_RT_self = sim_mean_rt_self,
    sim_mean_RT_stranger = sim_mean_rt_stranger,
    sim_mean_ACC_self = sim_mean_acc_self,
    sim_mean_ACC_stranger = sim_mean_acc_stranger,
    # 误差
    err_d_RT = err_d_rt,
    err_d_ACC = err_d_acc,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
  
  # 打印结果
  cat(sprintf("%s:\n", r$design_name))
  cat(sprintf("  d_RT: 实证=%.3f, 模型=%.3f, 误差=%.3f\n", 
              r$emp_d_RT, sim_d_rt, err_d_rt))
  cat(sprintf("  d_ACC: 实证=%.3f, 模型=%.3f, 误差=%.3f\n",
              r$emp_d_ACC, sim_d_acc, err_d_acc))
  cat(sprintf("  Mean RT (self): 实证=%.0fms, 模型=%.0fms\n",
              r$emp_mean_RT_self, sim_mean_rt_self))
  cat(sprintf("  Mean RT (stranger): 实证=%.0fms, 模型=%.0fms\n",
              r$emp_mean_RT_stranger, sim_mean_rt_stranger))
  cat("\n")
}

# 计算总体MAE
total_mae_d_rt <- mean(comparison$err_d_RT)
total_mae_d_acc <- mean(comparison$err_d_ACC)
max_err_d_rt <- max(comparison$err_d_RT)
max_err_d_acc <- max(comparison$err_d_ACC)

cat("=== 总体误差 ===\n")
cat(sprintf("MAE d_RT = %.4f\n", total_mae_d_rt))
cat(sprintf("MAE d_ACC = %.4f\n", total_mae_d_acc))
cat(sprintf("最大误差 d_RT = %.4f\n", max_err_d_rt))
cat(sprintf("最大误差 d_ACC = %.4f\n", max_err_d_acc))
```

## 8. 可视化

### 8.1 d_RT对比图

```{r plot-d-rt, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# ==============================================================================
# 可视化：d_RT 实证 vs 模型
# ==============================================================================

# 准备绘图数据 - 使用简化方法
plot_data <- rbind(
  data.frame(design = comparison$design, 类型 = "实证数据", d_RT = comparison$emp_d_RT),
  data.frame(design = comparison$design, 类型 = "模型预测", d_RT = comparison$sim_d_RT)
)

# 绘制分组条形图
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = design, y = d_RT, fill = 类型)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "d_RT 对比：实证数据 vs 模型预测",
    x = "实验条件",
    y = "Cohen's d (RT)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray")
```
